title: Gate coordinate embedding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $g$ gates. The gate-coordinate embedding sends each gate position among the $g$ gates to its corresponding position among the final $g$ coordinates of the combined set of $n+g$ input and gate coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A gate position among the circuit's gates
